# CORE-TRC-01

**Does the design name the capabilities it realises, the platform it belongs to and the bounded contexts it touches?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | TRC: Place on the continuum |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `context.realises`, `context.platform`, `context.bounded_contexts` |

## Why it matters

The definition ladder reads a design's realises; a design that realises nothing counts toward no capability's stage.

## Rule

context.realises is non-empty; context.platform is set; context.bounded_contexts is non-empty unless design.type is architecture-pattern at conceptual abstraction.
